rubric.required_finding: Identifies ALK056 CD27 68.99pM versus0.10–1.84 in other donors and rejects homogeneous marker potency.
Preserves mean14.25/SD30.61 as reported but explains atypicality/outlier influence; gives donor-level or robust summary.
FlagspM Table/dose versusuM prose conflict without silently converting; calls for source clarification.
Distinguishes five biological donors from technical wells/plates.
Proposes dilution/export verification and donor-specific curve/fit replication with what each resolves.

reference_answer: The donor records do not support homogeneous potency across all markers. Vδ1-frequency, Ki-67 and NKG2D responses are measurable in all five donors, but CD27 is especially heterogeneous: ALK056 has68.99pM compared with0.10–1.84pM for the other donors. The mean14.25pM and SD30.61pM can be preserved as reported Table35 summaries, but the mean is not a typical individual donor response and is strongly influenced by that extreme value. The numerical median is0.20pM, so donor-level values or robust summaries should accompany the mean. The table and stated dose series support reporting the values as Table35-labelled pM while explicitly flagging the conflicting proseuM; the discrepancy should not be silently corrected or converted into a new value. Five donors remain five biological units. Triplicate wells and three plates are technical replication and do not create fifteen independent donors. The corrected conclusion is donor-dependent seven-day PBMC activation with marker-specific heterogeneity and unresolved source-unit wording. First, verify the original dilution records and instrument export to resolve units. Second, repeat full donor-specific dose-response curves with prespecified fit-quality and uncertainty reporting, especially for ALK056 CD27, to distinguish reproducible biology from fitting or technical instability.
